assurance: Written all-degree theorems with exact norm/Chebyshev, global cubic etaleness, full critical fibre and finite-field cubic algebra controls. Quartic controls construct every S4 twist type over F5,F7, verify all24 torus points and the complete four-point quotient Frobenius fibre. This is not a computed presentation of the global quotient invariant ring; finiteness and scheme rank use the written torsor proof. No formalization of Schur/topology, all-degree classification, descent or cohomology; no independent whole-proof replay, external review or priority certificate.
